correctness.rationale: For smooth parameters the completed genus-one curve has omitted boundary H=<R> of order four. The divisor identities independently establish that order. Every open-curve automorphism extends to E and preserves H, hence is translation by H followed by an origin automorphism stabilizing H. An origin automorphism fixing R must be trivial in every characteristic: odd-order-3 automorphisms have deg(1-alpha)=3 and cannot fix four geometric points, while even-order elements yield inversion; in char2 the curve is ordinary and origin automorphisms are only ±1. Thus at most 8. Three explicit involutions have 8 distinct boundary permutations, giving equality; the invariant ring calculation via a free basis over k[A,A^-1] and Laurent inversion is exact even in char2. The verification program only tests the universal coordinate identities and boundary permutations.

value.rationale: Completes an intrinsically motivated full regular-automorphism classification for a smooth four-punctured elliptic family that has a widely studied explicit D8 subgroup. In particular it resolves whether exceptional elliptic complex multiplication produces extra regular symmetries (it does not), uniformly in characteristic 2, 3, and characteristic zero. It turns the previously known D8-invariant rational function into the true affine quotient coordinate for all regular automorphisms. A natural exact complete classification is mathematically useful without requiring downstream theorem claims; it is not presented as an invention of the known subgroup or invariant field.
